audience: consignment and resale store owners and staff who run their shop in ConsignCloud

useCases.title: Review the inventory by location and status
useCases.text: List the store locations, then list the items in one location by status. Open one item to read its price, cost and history.

useCases.title: Review sales and each consignor's share
useCases.text: List sales with totals and the consignor and store portions. Open one sale for its lines and payments, or read totals by day or week.

useCases.title: Find a consignor account and its balance
useCases.text: Search consignor and vendor accounts by name, email or number. Open one account to read its balance and default split.

useCases.title: Search the store for one record
useCases.text: Confirm the connected store, then search items, accounts and sales with one text query.

useCases.title: Add a new item and a note to it
useCases.text: Create an item in a consignor account, with its category. Then add a note to the item. Each create call adds a new record and does not check for duplicates.
